mechanism: Rizatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with guanfacine (alpha-2 agonist) may result in additive vasoconstrictive and CNS depressant effects, with potential for serotonergic activity potentiation.
action: Monitor for excessive vasoconstriction, blood pressure changes, and CNS depression; use lowest effective doses and consider alternative migraine therapy if combined use is necessary.
